purpose: Contracts and local hints, not a complete solution. Main owns numerical verification; existing successful Main checks must not be rerun merely for this fragment.

data.parse: 3 TAB fields source,target,attribution; third field metadata only
data.normalize: NBSP/narrow NBSP to ASCII space, lower, insert space before ,.!? if preceding char is not space, split whitespace, join single space; preserve accents/apostrophes
data.dedup: normalized full(source,target), keep first line and attribution
data.groupSplit: normalized source SHA256(UTF8("p9-v1\t" + source)) first8 hex -> integer %100; <80 train,<90 val,else test; salt uses actual TAB not literal backslash+t
data.order: original file order within split; first512 train/first64 val
data.vocab: independent source/target fit only selected512 pre-truncation tokens; minfreq1; descending frequency then Unicode lexical
data.truncate: first11 content tokens + EOS; right-pad to12; effective lengths include EOS
data.test: partitioned and counted only, not evaluated
requiredEvidence: duplicate count and source/pair cross-split nonoverlap
split/subset counts, line IDs and hashes
source/target truncated count; nonempty effective lengths
public displayed sample attribution plus modification notice

realRun.trainingLoss: sum masked token CE / number valid target tokens including EOS
realRun.reportCE: frozen eval sumNLL/sumTokens; not unweighted mean of batches
realRun.fairness: same samples, vocabularies, order and update budget; report different parameter counts; Main also matches common initial weights
realRun.encoder: packing must affect terminal hidden, not only attention mask
realRun.baselineState: immutable encoder context plus mutable decoder hidden; fixed context remains differentiable during training
realRun.inferenceInputs: source IDs, effective source lengths, generated history ONLY
realRun.candidatePolicy: full-vocabulary log_softmax then candidate exclusion, no renormalization; UNK allowed

search.prune: raw accumulated logprob shared active+finished pool; finished unchanged
search.final: prefer finished if pool contains any; otherwise mark unfinished
search.rank: sumLogProb / length**0.6; length includes EOS excludes BOS
search.state: parent gather every dynamic state, memory/source identity/length, context, history, attention history; same parent may produce multiple children

corpusMetric.name: BLEU2
corpusMetric.reference: full raw normalized tokens, NOT vocab-mapped and NOT truncated
corpusMetric.aggregation: clip per sentence then sum matches/totals; corpus BP using summed candidate/ref lengths
corpusMetric.emptyAndMissingOrder: 0; empty hypothesis still contributes reference length

realRun.sentenceDiagnostic: BLEU2; bigram add1 only; effective order min(2,candidateLength); unigram unsmoothed; empty0; never average as corpus metric
realRun.fixedVisualization: first selected validation sample, original line58; no post-result selection; use exact same greedy forward weights; source EOS included, PAD excluded in figure but verified zero in underlying log
prohibitedClaims: synthetic kernel curve is translation training
equal H is equal parameter capacity
short512/64 sample represents full MT quality
